name: Web Annotator (Prototype)
description: Highlight, comment on, and draw (pencil, shapes, text) over any webpage, with custom colors and undo/redo. Click the toolbar icon to turn it on for the current tab. Annotations persist locally, re-anchor on reload, and sync live with anyone else viewing the same page via a small realtime server.

action.default_title: Toggle Web Annotator on this page
